text: The CRP featured the Regionwide River Berm Transition Programme, which spanned 1,600 km across 23 rivers, focusing on native flora regeneration to improve flood conveyance and biodiversity. The programme integrated soft engineering and wetland enhancement with traditional flood protection, promoting multi-benefit corridors and cultural outcomes. It was supported by a 64% grant from Kānoa and a 36% local share, accelerating intergenerational flood resilience works.
